# Homefront Builders

> Homefront Builders is a luxury custom home builder serving Clarksville, TN and Middle Tennessee, with 20+ years of expertise, transparent budgeting, and superior craftsmanship.

Homefront Builders designs and builds custom homes across Middle Tennessee. The site covers the company's building process, available floor plans, active listings, client testimonials, and its new-home warranty program.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.homefrontbuilderstn.com/): Custom home builder in Clarksville, TN and Middle Tennessee — luxury custom homes with transparent budgeting and 20+ years of expertise. Features the announcement of Rustic Pines at Paris Landing, the new wooded community near Kentucky Lake headlined by Homefront Builders, with its promo film.
- [About Us](https://www.homefrontbuilderstn.com/about-us): The story behind Homefront Builders, Clarksville's premier luxury custom home builder, with over two decades of design and construction expertise.
- [Our Process](https://www.homefrontbuilderstn.com/process): How Homefront Builders manages every stage of a custom home build, from site analysis to final walkthrough, with precision and full transparency.
- [Floor Plans](https://www.homefrontbuilderstn.com/floorplans): Custom home floor plans — the Cypress, Dogwood, Harmony, Magnolia, and Myrtle — with stunning exteriors and highly functional layouts.
- [Rustic Pines at Paris Landing](https://www.homefrontbuilderstn.com/rustic-pines): Interactive lot map for 41 wooded homesites (5.39–24.43 acres) at Rustic Pines at Paris Landing in Stewart County, TN, near Paris Landing and Kentucky Lake — land from $79,000, or completed Homefront home-and-lot packages from $449,000 (package pricing excludes lot prep and utilities). The community's own website: https://www.rusticpinesparislanding.com/
- [Listings](https://www.homefrontbuilderstn.com/listings): Active custom home listings and luxury new construction available now in Clarksville, TN and Middle Tennessee.
- [Warranties](https://www.homefrontbuilderstn.com/warranties): The 10-year Quality Builders Warranty (QBW) backed by Liberty Mutual, and the Custom Care Program: proactive warranty support and scheduled maintenance.
- [Testimonials](https://www.homefrontbuilderstn.com/testimonials): What Homefront Builders clients say about building their luxury custom home in Middle Tennessee.
- [Blog](https://www.homefrontbuilderstn.com/blog): Home building tips, design inspiration, and local market insights from the Homefront Builders team.
- [Contact Us](https://www.homefrontbuilderstn.com/contact-us): Get in touch to start your custom home journey in Clarksville, TN.

## Key facts

- Business: Homefront Builders, a luxury custom home builder based in Clarksville, Tennessee, with 20+ years of experience building custom homes.
- Service area: Clarksville and Montgomery County, and the wider Middle Tennessee region, including Stewart County (Rustic Pines at Paris Landing).
- What they build: custom homes and new construction, from ready-to-build floor plans or a design made around the client's wants, needs and land.
- Floor plans (starting sizes): The Cypress (4 bed, 2 bath, 2,650 sq ft), The Dogwood (4 bed, 2.5 bath, 2,600 sq ft), The Harmony (4 bed, 3.5 bath, 2,860 sq ft), The Magnolia (5 bed, 3 bath, 2,650 sq ft), The Myrtle (4 bed, 2 bath, 1,900 sq ft).
- Warranty: every home comes with a 10-year Quality Builders Warranty (QBW) backed by Liberty Mutual, plus the Homefront Custom Care Program (proactive warranty support and maintenance).
- Building process: nine steps that spell HOMEFRONT: Have you met with us?, Outstanding Realtor, Money (assess your buying power), Evaluating your wants and needs, Floor plan and land, Rounding it out, Options for selections, No freaking out, TADA! Time to close.
- Rustic Pines at Paris Landing: 41 wooded homesites (5.39 to 24.43 acres) in Stewart County near Paris Landing and Kentucky Lake; land from $79,000, or Homefront home-and-lot packages from $449,000 (package pricing excludes lot prep and utilities).
- Contact: (931) 221-2566, homefrontsalesTN@gmail.com, Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm.
